newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley sees Cimpor gains.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley sees Cimpor gains.

text.p: Morgan Stanley said that it saw shares in Portuguese cement group Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal reaching 4,500 escudos within the next 12 months.
The stock was down 29 at 3,770 escudos on Monday.
Within 18 months, the stock could be at 5,000 escudos, the investment house said in a study to which Reuters had access.
"Recently, we revised upwards our forecasts for the (share) quotation of Cimpor," Morgan Stanley said.
The improved stock price outlook reflected the fundamentals of the company, a recent asset revaluation and the favourable macro-economic scene, it said.
It said it saw cement demand growing around seven to eight percent in 1997, similar to last year.
It said that it had increased its forecast for cashflow per share for 1997 and 1998 to 564 and 607 escudos, against 485 and 516 escudos, previously.
